harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native-machine-tv-recheck route on a real mumei.native-bundle/v1 built from a straight-line pure-i64 atom. The bounded profile covers leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call functions; conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching, while direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites. Cyclic control flow and loops remain outside. The register convention is assumed, not verified; the descriptor discharges only checks Core lists as performed. There is no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim; object_translation_correspondence remains unperformed, and a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm, the same atom used by the #1053 real-Core integration test.
Step 1 builds a real native bundle, verifies its pinned exit status and empty stdout/stderr digests, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the build ID.

Step 2 runs native-machine-tv-recheck and asserts the bounded leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call machine-TV profile; this atom has no branches or calls, so all branch and conditional-call checks remain in checks_not_performed. Conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching; direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites when present. The register convention is assumed, function outcomes are aggregate without function names, and full object TV remains outside the profile.

Step 3 reruns with a wrong build ID and asserts no machine-TV outcome, no selected result, full C02/object checks_not_performed including machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv, machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv, machine_code_direct_call_site_tv, and machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv, and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Machine-TV Recheck (native-machine-tv-recheck)
description: C10 Option B leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call machine-code translation-validation demo: native-machine-tv-recheck runs Core's recheck-machine-tv route on a real bundle, reports the assumed (not verified) register convention and aggregate function outcomes, compares direct calls as uninterpreted call sites when present, and matches conditional calls in branching functions per path under guards. It discharges only checks Core lists as performed. This atom has no branches or calls, so its branch and conditional-call TV checks remain unperformed; cyclic control flow and loops stay outside. It makes no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim and leaves object_translation_correspondence unperformed.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-machine-tv-recheck route on a real native bundle: the bounded profile covers leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call functions; conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching, while direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites. Cyclic control flow and loops remain outside; this atom has no branches or calls, so those checks remain unperformed. The register convention is assumed, not verified; there is no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim; and object_translation_correspondence stays unperformed. A wrong build ID must not produce a selected outcome.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1 with machine_tv_recheck == 'checked', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], checks_not_performed == ['file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], machine_tv_schema == 'mumei.machine-code-tv/v1', register_convention_assumed == 'sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_result_rax', function_outcomes == {'equivalent_within_profile': 1, 'outside_profile': 1}, no function names in the report, a selected_result and no candidate

wrong_report.json carries no machine_tv_recheck or discharged_checks, checks_not_performed == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with pinned outputs
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==7, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins program exit status 7 and empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds the declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the record pins program exit status 7 and both output channels.

steps.name: native-machine-tv-recheck reports the bounded branch-aware profile
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['machine_tv_recheck']=='checked', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['machine_tv_schema']=='mumei.machine-code-tv/v1', r; assert r['register_convention_assumed']=='sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_result_rax', r; assert r['function_outcomes']=={'equivalent_within_profile':1,'outside_profile':1}, r; text=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True); assert '\"__mumei_user_main\"' not in text and '\"main\"' not in text, text; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('native-machine-tv-recheck: leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call profile; conditional calls match per-path under guards; direct calls are uninterpreted sites; cyclic control flow and loops outside; no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json carries the matching machine-TV schema and assumed register convention, aggregate function outcomes without function names, a selected result, and the bounded leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call profile; this atom has no branches or calls, so those checks remain in checks_not_performed. Conditional calls in branching functions use per-path guarded call matching; cyclic control flow and loops stay outside, direct calls remain uninterpreted call sites when present, and full object TV remains unperformed.
steps.verifier_gate: native-machine-tv-recheck exits 0 with the matching build ID; the report claims only the supported leaf straight-line, forward-branch, acyclic backward-branch, and conditional-call profile, uses per-path guarded call matching for conditional calls, treats direct calls as uninterpreted call sites, leaves cyclic control flow and loops outside, and makes no ABI/runtime or full object-TV claim.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no machine-TV outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'machine_tv_recheck' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv', 'machine_code_direct_call_site_tv', 'machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv', 'machine_code_leaf_function_tv', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence', 'object_translation_correspondence', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code')==1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no machine-TV outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json carries no machine_tv_recheck, no discharged_checks, the sorted full C02/object checks_not_performed vocabulary including machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv, machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv, machine_code_direct_call_site_tv, machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv, and machine_code_leaf_function_tv, no selected_result, and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: A mismatched build ID exits 1 and produces no claimed machine-TV outcome.
